# Itai Agami

> Itai Agami is an independent Creative Director based in Tel Aviv, Israel, working with brands and teams internationally (remotely, and on site where needed; English and Hebrew). He leads creative direction for companies launching or changing something, covering positioning, the central creative idea, brand identity, launch campaigns, websites and digital experiences, motion, film, 3D, AI-assisted production and interactive experiences, and brings in the specialists each project needs while remaining the senior creative lead. Independent engagements typically begin at ₪30,000 in Israel, $10,000 in the US and Canada, €10,000 in Europe and £8,000 in the UK.

## Who hires him

Founders, CMOs, heads of brand and marketing, and product leaders at startups, technology companies, consumer brands, media organisations and cultural institutions, when they are launching a product, app, service, brand, campaign or development, entering a new market, or need ongoing creative leadership without a full-time Creative Director.

## Background

Independent Creative Director since 2026. Previously Creative Art Director (in-house) at Natural Intelligence (2025–2026), Creative Director at Elements (2023–2024) and Art Director at Shortcut Playground (2021–2023). Media Design, Shenkar College of Engineering, Design and Art (graduated with honors). Sectors: technology and product, media and broadcast, museums and cultural institutions, commerce and consumer brands.

Clients usually arrive with a launch or a business problem rather than a design deliverable. The work is to define what the launch needs to say, the central idea, how the brand looks and behaves, how the idea carries into campaign, product, website and content, and which specialists are needed to make it. Each case study states his individual contribution; much of the earlier work was made as part of agency and studio teams, and is credited that way.

## Services

- [Brand Strategy & Identity Systems](https://itaiagami.com/services/brand-strategy-identity-systems.html): positioning, the central idea, visual language and brand systems.
- [Creative Direction for Product & Brand Launches](https://itaiagami.com/services/creative-direction-product-launches.html): product, app and brand launches: the idea a launch rests on, carried through identity, campaign, film, website and production.
- [Interactive & Immersive Experiences](https://itaiagami.com/services/interactive-immersive-experiences.html): interactive installations, museum exhibitions, projection mapping and branded digital experiences.
- [Fractional Creative Direction & Creative Systems](https://itaiagami.com/services/fractional-creative-direction.html): a fractional creative director offering ongoing creative leadership and creative systems (including AI-assisted workflows) for teams without a Creative Director.
- [Services overview and FAQ](https://itaiagami.com/services.html)

## Selected work

- [Channel 13](https://itaiagami.com/work/channel-13.html): national broadcast brand identity, as part of the Shortcut Playground team.
- [Museum of Natural History](https://itaiagami.com/work/museum-of-natural-history.html): art direction and experience design; led the multidisciplinary team from concept to installed exhibit.
- [Partner TV](https://itaiagami.com/work/partner-tv.html): art direction of a channel-ID system across three channels, with Studio Adam Fineberg.
- [SkyMax](https://itaiagami.com/work/sky-max.html): art direction and concept art for a national commercial for MAX.
- [Simply Vision Pro](https://itaiagami.com/work/simply-vision-pro.html): creative direction and 3D for the launch visualization of Simply Piano on Apple Vision Pro (the visualization, not the wider product launch).
- [Tower of David](https://itaiagami.com/work/tower-of-david.html): art direction and illustration language for interactive exhibitions in Jerusalem.
- [Mako 12+](https://itaiagami.com/work/mako-12.html): the campaign that launched the 12+ streaming service.
- [Natural Intelligence](https://itaiagami.com/work/natural-intelligence.html): in-house Creative Art Director, 2025–2026; creative systems and an AI-assisted adaptation workflow.
- [Full work index](https://itaiagami.com/work.html)
